title: Marketing Intern
job_period: Immediate Start, For At Least 3 Months
description:
About the Role
We’re looking for an organised, proactive and creative Marketing Accounts Intern to join our team!
You’ll work closely with the Founder and Account Manager to support and manage BBS’ client accounts — from understanding what clients need and coordinating campaigns to making sure projects, content and deliverables stay on track.
This is a hands-on role where you’ll get exposure to both client servicing and marketing execution.
What You’ll Be Doing
Support the day-to-day management of assigned client accounts
Communicate and coordinate with clients on ongoing projects and deliverables
Work with the team to develop content ideas and campaign concepts
Assist with monthly content planning and content calendars
Coordinate with designers, videographers, creators and other team members
Prepare briefs and ensure deliverables are completed according to requirements
Keep track of timelines, approvals, feedback and outstanding items
Assist with client meetings, meeting notes and follow-ups
Monitor clients’ social media accounts, competitors and industry trends
Assist with monthly reports and identify useful insights
Support campaign launches, shoots and other marketing activities
Ensure that what we promise our clients actually gets done — and done well
Occasional graphic design work (simple ones!)
Who We’re Looking For
Someone who owns their work.
Currently studying Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field
Organised and good at keeping track of multiple moving parts
Comfortable communicating with clients
Creative and genuinely interested in marketing and social media
Proactive — you don’t always wait to be told what to do
Able to communicate clearly and professionally
Detail-oriented and responsible with deadlines
Comfortable working in a fast-moving boutique agency environment
Experience is a plus, but initiative, attitude and willingness to learn matter more to us!

title: Product Design Intern (UI/UX)
job_period: Immediate Start, For At Least 3 Months
description:
Job Overview:
We are looking for a Product Design Intern (UI/UX) to support the design of AIKIT's mobile app and vending machine kiosk experiences. You will work closely with the Product Design Lead on UI execution, design system maintenance, prototyping, design QA, and user research. This is an onsite internship in Singapore for 3-6 months; full-time is preferred, with part-time considered case by case.
You will not be expected to own large product problems independently. You should be able to keep smaller design tasks moving, maintain design quality, and help the team stay on track with the product cycle.
Key Responsibilities:
Design and refine UI for our mobile app and vending machine kiosk.
dentify and design missing states, edge cases, and interaction details.
Maintain and improve our Figma design system, components, and files.
Create interactive prototypes for new and existing user flows.
Conduct design QA and flag visual or interaction inconsistencies.
Support user research, usability testing, and synthesis of findings.
Prepare designs and assets for developer handoff.
Work with developers on design clarifications as you gain product experience.
Requirements:
Currently pursuing a university degree or a fresh graduate in Singapore.
Background in Product Design, UI/UX, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field.
Strong visual design fundamentals with good attention to detail.
Portfolio required, showing relevant UI/visual design work and your design process.
Strong proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping.
Able to execute motion graphics and UI animation for product interactions.
Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator and AI design tools.
Good understanding of components, design systems, and consistent UI patterns.
Responsible, proactive, and able to work independently, taking initiative while knowing when to ask for help.
Able to manage tasks and keep up with product development timelines.
Curious about users and comfortable participating in user research.
